rules.SUPER_RARE: May output SUPER_RARE parts except cage controller, or downgrade to the four listed RARE parts.

implementation: The existing engine already consumes the actual input instance and grants one random member of the full observed output pool immediately. This audit adds regressions and evidence without changing output frequencies.
unverified: The 77 observations are not exact server probabilities and do not prove dependence or independence from a particular SR input item.
PRTS mentions a previous-step button during exchange; the user rules out returning after random SR resolution. No reward preview or post-resolution undo is modeled.
